name: react-boilerplates
description: React 프로젝트 보일러플레이트 모노레포 (pnpm 10 workspace + catalog)
author: blue45f

scripts.build-storybook:bootstrap: pnpm --dir templates/lib install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm --dir templates/lib run build-storybook
scripts.build:react: pnpm --dir templates/app run build && pnpm --dir templates/admin run build && pnpm --dir templates/lib run build
scripts.install:templates: pnpm --dir templates/app install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm --dir templates/admin install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm --dir templates/lib install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
scripts.e2e:app:bootstrap: pnpm --dir templates/app install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm --dir templates/app run test:e2e
scripts.e2e:admin:bootstrap: pnpm --dir templates/admin install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm --dir templates/admin run test:e2e
scripts.verify:templates:bootstrap: pnpm install:templates && pnpm --dir templates/app run verify && pnpm --dir templates/admin run verify && pnpm --dir templates/lib run verify
scripts.verify:templates: pnpm --dir templates/app run verify && pnpm --dir templates/admin run verify && pnpm --dir templates/lib run verify
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm verify:templates:bootstrap
scripts.verify:push: pnpm verify && pnpm lint:secrets && pnpm audit:security:templates
scripts.audit:security:templates: pnpm --dir templates/app run lint:security && pnpm --dir templates/admin run lint:security && pnpm --dir templates/lib run lint:security
scripts.clean: pnpm -r run clean && rm -rf node_modules templates/app/node_modules templates/admin/node_modules templates/lib/node_modules
